steps.content: Grand Stall in Drifter Camp's Square
Dozens of execs have broken into Drifter Camp and are confronting the crowd.
The female executive at the head of the group proclaims in an icy voice.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: Mania mutation has been confirmed inside Drifter Camp. There is a confirmed Mania field and contaminations. We have captured an A-Class Sinner.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: <size=32>To sum up, the Reconstruction Executive Committee shall thoroughly investigate all dangerous phenomena, and once private possession of Hypercubes, Mania weapons, or any suspicious prohibited powers are found, they will be strictly dealt with!</size>

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: Don't resist the orders, don't hinder the execution, or else...

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Eastside bastards! We didn't do anything wrong. We never touched Mania contaminations. You're accusing the wrong people. Give me my parents back!
The doctor hurriedly pulls Ica back and covers the child's eyes, which are somewhat red from anger. His own hands are also trembling slightly.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: What should we do...? Dudu is captured, and that person... and Granny Margaret...
Instead of confronting the crowd, the lead executive wanders over to his group, crouches down, takes Granny Margaret's hand, and speaks softly with a smile, ignoring the tension at the scene.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: ...Who... Who's back?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's me, Margaret. It's Donald.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: ...Who are you?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Donald.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Do-Donald?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Donald.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Don...Don?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Donald.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Don... Donny... Donna... Don... Don...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Yeah, Donald the duck. Don Don, Donny Aroman, it's all me. I'm back.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: How come you're still not back?...

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Enough!!!
He rushes over, swats away the executive with a punch, picks up Granny Margaret, and runs back into the crowd.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Why? What's gotten you so riled up? I was just saying hello to dear Margaret. Why are you so angry?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You are the ones who have done bad things. Why are you acting like justice is on your side? Look at this woman, and look at you! An evil force is spreading!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Do you know how many people in the camp have been corrupted? Have you really not had any nightmares these past few nights? Guess who secretly introduced that monster into Drifter Camp, huh? And for what?
The crowd lets out shouts of alarm. They start to murmur with suppressed panic.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Drifter Camp doesn't have that kind of evil power. We have our own anti-Mania system. Furian didn't go crazy and turn into a Corruptor. She left this world because she was in too much pain.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: And all her suffering was caused by you. You have taken away Syndicate's hope.
People in cloaks suddenly appear on the upper level, clutching their guns with anger in their eyes.
The young man in the lead speaks in a calm tone, and his face is back to icy cold.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: "The gangs have caused all these. They have gone mad in their pursuit of violence, and they are the ones who have made you suffer."

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But I heard that you guys have been very successful recently. You finally have the ability to fight back against them. You've won many times, even facing Mania weapons.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Isn't it because you're secretly using the same kind of power? Isn't that why there's now a Mania mutation in your backyard?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: You're the ones who colluded with the gangsters, who let them use Mania power, and now you're blaming it on Drifter Camp? You are just looking for a reason to crack down on us!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: There can be many reasons. That Mania specialist we got, that Chief, went missing on your turf. Can you explain what happened?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: There was a gangster attack.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Haha, haha... You're still so naive. Whatever reason or evidence you have, as long as they don't want to hear it, it won't work. There are already suspicions about you using Mania weapons.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Leave Drifter Camp. Be smart about this, or they will think you want to use Mania and go on the same path as the Legion...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: When my big guns arrive, it will be the end of this place!

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...How dare you mention that?!
He raises his gun at the executive named Donald, and almost simultaneously, all the armed individuals on both sides raise their weapons.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hey, hey, drop the gun, kid. We can still talk about this.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Give those two back. I'm not buying your shit.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Isn't it what you want, me raising this gun? I know almost too well what you're trying to do. Inspecting without reason, interfering, harassing, and weaving charges every now and then to pick a fight...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Drifter Camp is a pain in the ass, and some people want us gone, but they can't deal with us the way they did with the gangs.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: That's why you're forcing us into a corner, and when we light a fire, you'll be able to eradicate Drifter Camp as you did with the Legion!
The crowd erupts when they hear the Legion's name.

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content:
So the Legion was really set up? The Black Ring wasn't set off by them?
What about Zoya? Was she killed?!
Bastards, I knew none of you were any good!!!
Do you want to do it to us again?!

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Come on, then. I've put up with it for a long time.
He slams a mechanism on the side, and the ground suddenly caves in. You, Dudu, and the guards on the side all fall straight down, and several armed personnel are there to catch you.
The sound of intense shooting comes from above, and at the same time, you hear a familiar voice.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief.
The two Sinners are right next to you!
But before you have a chance to greet them, a pistol is held against your temple.

steps.speaker: Drifter Camp Force
steps.content: Go help, or I'll shoot him.
steps.female_content: Go help, or I'll shoot her.

steps.speaker: Drifter Camp Force
steps.content: Cut the crap. Do it now!
Her palm is sweaty, and you can force the Potestas to knock her out, but now... seems to be a "real chance."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They will need it.
